tools.name: light.info
tools.description: Inspect a photo in the light engine's workspace (RAW: DNG, CR2/CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, ORF, RW2, PEF...; or JPEG, PNG, TIFF): its size and summary, and every EXIF/TIFF/GPS tag and XMP property. Reads only. `path` is relative to that workspace, a private folder only the light.* tools read and write; files elsewhere on the device are not in it and cannot be named.

tools.name: light.controls
tools.description: List the light engine's develop controls (id, label, range, default): the valid keys of `params` for light.develop and light.batch, such as light.exposure, light.contrast, color.vibrance or wb.temp. Reads only.

tools.name: light.develop
tools.description: Develop one photo in the light engine's workspace and export it to `out`, whose extension picks the format (.jpg, .png, .tif, .webp, .avif or .dng). `params` maps develop control ids (see light.controls) to numbers; `auto` runs auto-tone first; `long_edge` caps the output size; `quality` is 1 to 100 (default 92). Both paths are relative to that workspace; nothing is written outside it, a file already at `out` is replaced, and an original is never overwritten.

tools.name: light.batch
tools.description: Apply one develop to 1 to 16 photos in the light engine's workspace, writing each as `<out_dir>/<name>.<format>` (format jpg by default). `params`, `auto`, `long_edge` and `quality` are as for light.develop. Two inputs with the same file name are refused. All paths are relative to that workspace; nothing is written outside it, existing outputs are replaced, and an original is never overwritten.
